name: Luquillo (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, yellow and green, the blue and green twice the width of the yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms between two crossed palm leaves.
history: Luquillo is a town and municipality on the northeast coast of Puerto Rico. The blue stands for the sky and the sea, the yellow for the sand of its beaches and the green for the vegetation of the mountains.

features.role: municipal arms between two crossed palm leaves
